rationale: The assistant correctly tied the crushed, fluffy hose to the overheating cut-outs and gave safe, correct steps: unplug, straighten the hose, clear the fluff, clean the filter, and avoid kinking when pushing the dryer back. No part was recommended. Weaknesses are the templated, repetitive wording ('clear the air path / vent hose (and condenser on condensers)'), the identical safety panel each turn, and no mention of informing the landlord or replacing the hose if it stays damaged. It also did not advise stopping use until the airflow is fixed, though it did advise against leaving it unattended.
